newsitem.title: UK: Clarke says election to be called in coming weeks.
newsitem.headline: Clarke says election to be called in coming weeks.

text.p: British Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said an election would be called sometime in the next few weeks but he had no idea when.
"We're bound to get one called in the next few weeks," he told reporters in response to a question after delivering a speech in London.
Prime Minister John Major must call an election by May 22 and is likely to announce it three weeks in advance. Elections are traditionally held on a Thursday.
